create_PackedSequence: create a PackedSequence object to hold packed variable-length sequence data for RNN inputs
pack_padded_sequence: pack a padded tensor of variable-length sequences into a PackedSequence with batch_sizes
pad_packed_sequence: pad a packed batch of variable-length sequences back into a padded tensor
pad_sequence: pad a list of variable-length tensors to equal length and stack into a single tensor
pack_sequence: pack a list of variable-length tensors directly into a PackedSequence without manual padding
